brief: Two minors JS-037's last review left: an approval that outlives its client delayed shutdown to 29 s with an 8 s grace and the database stalled, and one that failed after its client hung up logged nothing.
entry: JS-037 bounds an in-flight approval by the shutdown grace and logs a failed approval.
serves: docs/running.md: the process exits within seconds of the grace; 'every failure is reported with its reason'.
